experiment: V92 bounded day-23 hour-23 shed-capacity guard on the frozen V50 lineage

packaging.embedded_v50_encoding: base64 of the exact bytes of experiments/v50_agent.py, decoded and exec'd at import
packaging.why: the Kaggle submission runner receives only this one file; reading V50 from an absolute local path would raise inside the frozen agent's try/except, fall through to its all-PASS fallback, and silently submit a do-nothing agent
checks: embedded text decodes to experiments/v50_agent.py byte-for-byte (sha e6b50128e023e3b9)
a full 720-step game completes with only this file copied into an empty temp directory

guard.projection: shed_now + carried_now + committed_WHEAT_buys + committed_FERTILIZER_buys + HARVEST_ALLOWANCE(6) > shedCapacity(100)
actions_when_triggered: trim FERTILIZER first (cheaper unit, $29 vs WHEAT $37), then WHEAT, one unit per iteration up to 32 iterations, until the projection fits

reserve_floor.fert_keep: min(FERTILIZER ordered, MIN_FERT_RESERVE=4) - always buys some soil
reserve_floor.wheat_keep: min(WHEAT ordered, shed WHEAT already held) - never buys less wheat than already stored
reserve_floor.note: an earlier draft used a per-live-animal wheat floor; on the audited state that floor was 16 against a 16-unit buy, forbade trimming wheat entirely, and left a 28-unit excess uncorrectable. The floor was weakened deliberately because the stronger version made the guard inoperative.

never: touches SELL orders the frozen route already made
fires on any other day or hour

verified_on_audited_state.state: seed 92802, V50 seat 1, obs at day 23 hour 23 (from a saved head-to-head replay, SHA provenance)

seed_status: all already spent; 12 of the 28 spent seeds that have direct V50-vs-V56 head-to-head replays
seats: both ab and ba for every pairing
games: 48 (candidate vs V50, candidate vs V56) + 24 (frozen V50 control vs V56) = 72

predeclared_gate.zero_errors: candidate_errors + opponent_errors + infrastructure_errors + timeouts == 0 across all runs
predeclared_gate.no_score_rate_regression_vs_v56: candidate score_rate against V56 must be within 5 percentage points of the matched frozen V50 control score_rate against V56, same 12 seeds, both seats
predeclared_gate.on_pass: report to root; root decides on any Kaggle submission
predeclared_gate.on_fail: STOP. No tuning on the screen, no rerun, no fresh seed, no variant iteration.
